API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIAuthentication SettingsAuth Settings Resource Update Auth Settings
Auth Settings Resource Update Auth Settings
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/authSettings

Updates the organization's default authentication settings information.

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY

The default authentication settings information

orgAuthType
string
REQUIRED

User authentication type. Setting it to an LDAP-based authentication requires a complete LdapProperties configuration.

Possible values: [ANY, NONE, SAFECHANNEL_DIR, MICROSOFT_ACTIVE_DIR, OPENLDAP_DIR, NOVELL_DIR, IBM_DOMINO_DIR, SUN_DIR, SMAUTH_ENTERPRISE_HOSTED]

oneTimeAuth
string

When the orgAuthType is NONE, administrators must manually provide the password to new end users. For new users who have not yet authenticated, a one-time token or link with a temporary password is sent as an email by the security cloud. If SAML Single Sign-On is enabled, this one-time token is not applicable, and this field is ineffective.

Possible values: [OTP_DISABLED, OTP_TOKEN, OTP_LINK]

samlEnabled
boolean

Whether or not to authenticate users using SAML Single Sign-On. Enabling SAML requires complete SamlSettings.

kerberosEnabled
boolean

Whether or not to authenticate users using Kerberos

authFrequency
string

How frequently the users are required to authenticate (i.e., cookie expiration duration after a user is first authenticated). This field is not applicable to the Lite API.

Possible values: [DAILY_COOKIE, PERMANENT_COOKIE, SESSION_COOKIE, CUSTOM_COOKIE]

authCustomFrequency
int32

How frequently the users are required to authenticate. This field is customized to set the value in days. Valid range is 1–180.

This field is not applicable to the Lite API.

passwordStrength
string

Password strength required for form-based authentication of hosted DB users. Not applicable for other authentication types (e.g. SAML SSO or Directory).

Possible values: [NONE, MEDIUM, STRONG]

passwordExpiry
string

Password expiration required for form-based authentication of hosted DB users. Not applicable for other authentication types (e.g. SAML SSO or Directory).

Possible values: [NEVER, ONE_MONTH, THREE_MONTHS, SIX_MONTHS]

lastSyncStartTime
int32

Timestamp (epoch time in seconds) corresponding to the start of the last LDAP sync. This is reset when the organization's authentication type is changed to a different directory authentication type. Applicable only for directory-based authentication. This field is not applicable to the Lite API.

lastSyncEndTime
int32

Timestamp (epoch time in seconds) corresponding to the end of the last LDAP sync. This is reset when the organization's authentication type is changed to a different directory authentication type. Applicable only for directory-based authentication. This field is not applicable to the Lite API.

mobileAdminSamlIdpEnabled
boolean

Indicate the use of Mobile Admin as IdP

autoProvision
boolean

Enable SAML Auto-Provisioning

directorySyncMigrateToScimEnabled
boolean

Enable to disable directory synchronization for this user repository type so you can enable SCIM provisioning or SAML auto-provisioning. Use this setting to migrate from directory synchronization to SCIM provisioning.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA

string
